title: ObservableObject
description: A fixed-shape object whose properties notify on assignment: ```ts const stats = new ObservableObject({ health: 100, ammo: 30 }); const hud = ObservableObject.map(stats, s => `${s.health} HP | ${s.ammo} Ammo`); stats.health -= 10; stats.ammo--; ``` Each property is a native getter and setter on the instance; assigning a value that is equal by `Object.is` notifies nothing. Observation is shallow and the shape is fixed: the object is sealed, so adding a property throws in strict mode and deleting one fails. Objects and arrays can be stored as property values, but changes inside them are not observed; reassign the property or call ObservableObjectConstructor.markChanged. Spreading, `Object.keys` and `JSON.stringify` see the current values.
